Quantum 1.28.0 was certified on 2026-09-05. It pins **nucleus v1.24.0**, **quark v1.11.0** and **orbit v1.9.2**, with 22 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.27.0: nucleus goes from v1.23.2 to v1.24.0 (minor), quark goes from v1.10.1 to v1.11.0 (minor) and orbit goes from v1.9.0 to v1.9.2 (patch). 21 sibling modules change version.
